# The paths CI builds, runs or reads. A change touching any of them runs the full CI matrix; a change touching none of
# them is doc-only to CI, gets no run, and ci-docs-only-companion.yml reports the required checks for it.
#
# One list, read three ways: continuous-integration.yml carries it as its push and pull_request `paths` (a workflow
# trigger cannot read a file, so there it is copied, and CiTestedPathsTests fails when the copies differ);
# ci-docs-only-companion.yml and release.yml read this file through scripts/ci_path_filter.py.
#
# GitHub path-filter syntax, evaluated in order: `*` stays within one directory, `**` crosses them, a `!` line excludes
# what the lines above matched and a later line can match it again. When unsure whether CI reads a path, list it here:
# a wrong "tested" costs one run, a wrong "untested" lets a change reach main unchecked.

[tested]
Schema/**
SchemaQuench/**
SchemaTongs/**
DataTongs/**
SchemaShears/**
TestProducts/**
!**/*.md

# Top-level paths CI does not test, each a decision rather than a default: CiTestedPathsTests fails for a tracked
# top-level path that is on neither list. A path under one of these that CI does read (a docs page a test parses) is
# listed under [tested] above.
[untested]
